families.title: Research & institutional intelligence
families.description: Research foundations, diagnostic methods, analytical software, and external review share an evidence discipline. The E-PSM lineage runs from Dual-Sided Failure diagnosis through Innovation Bridge, E-PSM market architecture, BERHANE OS design and prototyping, to the PISCES 2.0 and Sovereign Studio public prototypes. These relationships describe research and design context; live system integration, external approval, and institutional partnership are not established.
